unlisted_practices: Cross-lingual training and data augmentation to improve multilingual clinical information extraction
Evidence-based question answering that highlights supporting text spans to enable human-in-the-loop verification of form-filling suggestions

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an evidence-based question-answering framework (using encoder and generative language models) to extract evidence and propose answers for stroke quality registry forms across multiple languages. It evaluates model accuracy and training strategies, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
